claims.title: Relational individuation
claims.summary: Genuine individuals may be dynamically maintained, relatively autonomous patterns constituted through relations rather than intrinsically independent substances.

claims.title: Novelty and emergence
claims.summary: Novel organization may constrain later processes; matched-joint mutual information cannot increase under deterministic grouping, so scale gains require explicit intervention and task assumptions and do not establish strong emergence.

claims.title: Selfhood as a multi-dimensional research question
claims.summary: Study answerable continuity of a public inquiry: whether preserved reasons for revisions change later judgment beyond matched archive access, without inferring subjective experience.
